item.title: Find The Needle
item.description:
Title: Find The Needle
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: Needless Games
Publisher: Needless Games
Release Date: Nov 6, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Nov 6, 2026




About This Game

You were a farmer.
At least, you think you were.
Now you're stuck inside a strange warehouse, standing in front of an endless haystack. You don't remember how you got here, who brought you here, or why the doors won't open.
There is only one instruction:
Find the needles.

There are some in the pile. You start by hand, with a metal detector. You end up with belts, balers, scanners and robotic arms doing the looking for you. Place real machines, wire the power, feed them by belt. Sell the hay, buy more machines, get given a bigger pile.

Nobody has said what happens when you finish.

The pile

Begin By Hand

The tools

Buy tools like shovels, buckets, wheelbarrows, pitchforks, vacuums. Anything that helps you process hay manually!

Start Automating

Automate everything! Build robots, drones, conveyor belts, hay wrappers, paper machines, sorting machines, and advanced systems that process hay and search for needles while you focus on expanding your factory.

Hay products

Turn ordinary hay into valuable products! Process it into hay pulp, compressed bales, eco bricks, hay paper, pellets, and much more. Build new production lines, unlock advanced machinery, and find better ways to turn your mountain of hay into profit.

Tech tree

Progress through a huge tech tree with over 300 upgrades! Unlock new machines, improve production speed, increase efficiency, expand your factory, and discover entirely new ways to process hay.

What happens when you collect all the needles?

- Who knows?

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Find The Needle has optional rude emotes: the middle finger and other rude hand signs, spitting, a crude sexual hand gesture and a peeing emote. They are switched off by default when you start and only appear after you turn on Rude Emotes in the You tab. Your character can also fall from a great height and flop over like a rag doll, with no blood.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: 4 cores / 8 threads, Intel i5-8400 or Ryzen 5 2600
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: dedicated GPU with Vulkan 1.3 support and 4 GB VRAM, GTX 1050 Ti or RX 570
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 3 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Integrated graphics are not supported and may crash
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
    • Processor: 6+ cores, Ryzen 5 5600 or Intel i5-12400
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 1660 Super, RTX 2060 with 6 GB VRAM
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 3 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Very large factories are CPU heavy. A faster CPU keeps the frame rate up late in the game

item.title: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor
item.description:
Title: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor
Genre: RPG
Developer: Stormfront Studios
Publisher: SNEG
Franchise: Dungeons & Dragons
Release Date: Nov 6, 2026




About This Game

Malevolence is afoot in the Forgotten Realms world: a new Pool of Radiance has been discovered beneath the city of New Phlan, and a wave of pure evil now emanates from it, cursing all it touches. Answer Elminster’s call, descend into the ruined Elven city of Myth Drannor and stop the sorceress and the dracolich before they turn the power of the Pool against the realm.

Create up to four heroes and recruit two more along the way, for a party of six. The game features the Dungeons & Dragons rules, with different races, classes and spells. Players may choose between the genuine turn-based style of role-playing and a more action-focused, timed-turn style of play. The optional turn timer makes for more engaging, higher-pressure fights.

Originally released in 2001, Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor revived one of the most storied names in cRPG history. Now it’s available digitally for the first time, with a full suite of enhancements. The re-release runs smoothly on modern hardware, includes sharper visuals, fixes numerous original game bugs and adds widescreen support, including 4K.

The improved UI adds an action bar and tooltips. It comes with full controller support and reworked camera control.

  • Return to the legendary Pool of Radiance - back to where the legacy began

  • Save Faerûn: answer Elminster’s call and stop the sorceress and the dracolich from using the power of the Pool of Radiance against the realm

  • Party of six: create up to four heroes and recruit two more along the way

  • Deep progression: level up characters to 16th level and cast 8th-level spells

  • Includes over 90 spells

  • Tactical turn-based combat and classic dungeon crawling for anyone hungry for more Dungeons & Dragons gameplay

  • Optional turn timer for more engaging, higher-pressure fights

  • Runs smoothly on modern hardware

  • Fixed numerous original game bugs

  • Widescreen support, including 4K

  • Sharper visuals

  • Improved UI with the addition of the action bar and tooltips

  • Adjustable combat animation speed

  • Optional "Legacy" mode that preserves original gameplay and visuals

  • Full controller support

  • Reworked camera control

  • Customize the scope of the enhancements with the in-game settings

  • Other Quality of Life improvements

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor is a game developed in 2001. According to official ratings from that time, it contains violence and blood. Might not be appropriate for all audiences.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10/11
    • Processor: 1.8 GHz
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: DirectX 9.0c Compatible Graphics Card
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 4 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

item.title: Piano Glow
item.description:
Title: Piano Glow
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation , Animation & Modeling , Audio Production , Video Production
Developer: TheAlanski
Publisher: TheAlanski
Release Date: Nov 6, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Mar 10, 2025




About This Game

PianoGlow, created by pianists, features:

Multiplayer

  • Show-off your piano skills & listen to others around the world.

  • Queue-based mode to take turns playing piano.

  • Several multiplayer modes, including queue, Mania (4K/7K), guess drawing (draw while playing piano), guess songs (players play a song and guess each other's song).

  • Global and private chatrooms. Voice chat and friend/block lists.

  • Offline and single-player mode.

Any keyboard: QWERTY computer/laptop, digital piano, any MIDI device or acoustic piano

  • Play any music or song with a QWERTY keyboard (laptop/computer).

  • Or connect to a real digital piano or MIDI controller via Bluetooth or USB-B.

  • Any song works with any size keyboard, even as small as 25, since the PianoGlow app can auto-convert any song or MIDI to a smaller one.

  • Velocity integration with Wooting Analog QWERTY keyboards so that you can play with dynamics on the computer keyboard (loud & soft).

  • Record & load MIDI files (live play or render as video from within the app).

  • Any songs can be converted to computer key controls, where each computer key corresponds to a note on the piano.

Training modes & tools

  • Unlimited use of AI converter tools, converting any piano video, PDF or audio into tutorials (MIDI files, falling notes).

  • Ear training, rhythm, falling notes, chord, scales, arpeggios & sheet music game modes. Perfect for all levels (including beginners with no experience).

  • Customizable setting in many training modes to auto-pause until you hit the next correct note/chord (auto-pause on by default).

  • Tracks stats and shows wrong answers more often to focus on your weaknesses. Unlock achievements!

  • Detailed calendar that shows exactly how much you practiced each day and month.

  • AI-based fingering, help determine which fingers to use on any MIDI file or song.

  • AI-based converter that adjusts any MIDI/MusicXML or song to fit into a smaller piano/keyboard.

  • Interactive Circle-of-Fifths cheat sheet - clicking shows the common chord triads, key signature and the 7th chords.

  • Automated Chord Name Identifier & Intervals when you play any chord on the piano.

  • Lighted Keyboards - lights up the indicators on your MIDI keyboard in falling notes.

  • Upload any MIDI or MusicXML file to practice music with, and it will show both Falling Notes and Sheet Music notation.

  • Set any custom time-range and loop practice it. It will remember the time-range for when you re-visit the song.

  • MIDI Editor - create new songs and edit your performances/recordings.

  • MIDI Loop - loop your playing and layer in different SoundFonts.

Customizable themes

  • 3D piano + 3D virtual hands that emulate playing, includes various 3D venues and 3D characters that can play.

  • Automatic cinematic camera movements, including POV camera to emulate POV playing.

  • 3D cats that sleep and walk around.

  • Stunning visuals & particle effects that move in sync with the tempo of your playing.

  • Upload video files as the background.

  • 3D sheet music visualization with glowing orbs and 3D lighting effects.

QWERTY features

  • Auto-play QWERTY sheet music (semi-auto included).

  • Typing game modes, where falling notes (and sheet music based notation) are also shown with QWERTY notes.

  • Velocity settings such as predictive or random velocity, adjust velocity curve and more.

  • Transpose detection - press TAB to auto-transpose to the next auto-detected transpose in QWERTY sheets, or hold transpose and press a number to manually jump to a specific transpose.

  • In-game notepad for you to load or edit QWERTY sheets, with transpose tools and OCR.

  • Convert MIDI files to QWERTY.

Customizable Audio

  • Customizable reverb & equalizer audio effects.

  • Upload custom SoundFont (.sf2, .sf3) files, VST3 support and ASIO support.

  • Load multiple SoundFonts simultaneously (e.g. one for left-hand vs right-hand).

  • Create your own SoundFonts (by loading an MP3 or WAV and it will let you export a SoundFont file)!

Community

  • Discord community server, chat and share tips about piano.

  • Dedicated website and regular social media content.

No Hidden Costs

  • Pay once and it's for a lifetime: all updates in the future will be included free as part of your one-time purchase (instead of DLCs), with a heavy focus on user-feedback as seen on the news.

  • No hidden costs. No microtransactions. No subscriptions.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Some 2D assets & UI are created with the assistance of AI.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) and Windows 10
    • Processor: 1.7 GHz Dual Core CPU
    • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
    • Graphics: Recommend at least a dedicated GPU
    • Storage: 800 MB available space
    • Sound Card: Any
* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.

MacOS

    Minimum:
    • OS: macOS 13 or later
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent (Apple M1 or later for Apple Silicon Macs)
    • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
    • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU with 2 GB VRAM
    • Storage: 800 MB available space

Linux

    Minimum:
    • OS: If you can run other Steam games and installed Steam via the official deb package, should likely be fine
    • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
    • Storage: 1100 MB available space

item.title: ZED ZONE
item.description:
Title: ZED ZONE
Genre: Action , Indie , RPG , Simulation
Developer: Leven Liu
Publisher: INDIECN
Release Date: Nov 5, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Mar 29, 2023




About This Game

  • Juggernaut : A pack-behavior infected that lives in symbiosis with its host organism. Yeah... it doesn't look friendly.

  • Breaker : Extremely destructive, unstable, aggressive, and short-tempered. If this thing rams into you, good luck putting yourself back together.

  • Fan Blade : A heavily modified mutant showing clear signs of artificial augmentation. We're still trying to figure out where the hell it came from.

  • Army Zombie : Damn! You must've been the kind of coward who was afraid to empty a full magazine when you were alive!

  • Flamethrower Zombie : Once a soldier who fell defending the city. Now it's everyone else's problem.

  • Firefighter Zombie : Never thought getting sprayed by this thing would hurt this much. I'm never playing with fire again.

  • Spider Robot : Four legs absolutely do NOT make it a spider. Who the hell named this thing—damn it, it saw me!

  • War Machine : So this is what they did with my tax money?! What else are they hiding from us?!

  • Giant Mutant Lizard : Wait... that thing used to be just a lizard? Has it gotten even bigger...? Oh crap, IT'S COMING!

  • Gun Modding System : Four attachment slots are now available: barrel, sight, stock, and shell collector. More than 40 weapon attachments can be installed, including scopes, night vision scopes, thermal sights, suppressed barrels, muzzle suppressors, tactical stocks, a Christmas-exclusive shell collector, and more. Mix and match attachments to freely customize weapon performance and handling.

  • Spray Paint System : Give your favorite weapon its own custom look. The game includes 8 built-in spray paints, and you can also import your own colors and images to create exactly the style you want.

  • Decals : The game also includes 8 built-in decals, and you can create custom stickers to give your weapons even more personality.

  • Construction & Production : From wells, furniture, and storage containers to furnaces and workbenches, gradually turn your base into a fully functional post-apocalyptic stronghold where you can live, craft, and produce supplies.

  • Power System : More than 10 electrical facilities and tools are now available, including generators, refrigerators, electric fences, energy storage modules, and more. It's time to light up the age of electricity once again.

  • Creative Building : Five types of material blocks are coming soon: wood, stone, metal, glass, and hay. Build your shelter however you want and create a base that truly belongs to you.

Survival is getting tougher by the day. If you want to sleep safely at night, you're going to need some serious defenses. Defensive structures and traps are already available, with automated firepower coming soon.

  • Defensive Structures : Wood Spike Traps, Metal Spike Traps, and Electric Fences help keep danger outside where it belongs.

  • Traps : Landmines, Handmade Landmines, High Explosive Landmines, and Homemade Barrel Bombs could be what gets you through the night.

  • Automated Firepower : Machine Gun Turrets, Tesla Turrets, Laser Turrets, and Crossbow Turrets. Another miracle of electrical engineering. Apocalypse-made, survivor-approved!

The game now features more than 200 craftable items , including food, medicine, tools, weapons, and other survival essentials.

  • Workbench : Craft the essentials you need to survive, along with the tools you'll never want to leave home without. And once you know what you're doing... you can probably make some pretty dangerous stuff too.

  • Lathe : In the apocalypse, if you need a part, you make it yourself. Just remember—there's no workers' compensation anymore, so watch your fingers.

  • Pharmaceuticals : It's the end of the world. You're seriously worried about allergies now? Drink it and hope for the best. If it keeps you alive, it works.

  • Chemical Experiments : This one's a little dangerous. Gunpowder, explosives, fuel... personally, I pay someone else to handle this stuff. Great output. Terrible employee retention.

The Skill System includes three major training categories: Melee, Firearms, and Fitness , with six progression directions covering blades, spears, crossbows, firearms, and more. With over 20 progression paths and 60+ skills , you can freely create your own build.

Using your PDA Terminal , you'll gradually unlock more skills. Mastering the right survival techniques might be the difference between making it home and becoming someone else's loot.

Your PDA doesn't just improve your basic capabilities—it can also provide active combat support through its onboard computing power.

Grapple, CAS System, Focused Laser Cannon, Western Gunslinger —use them at the right moment, and they might just save your life.

This time, we're adding an adorable dog to your team to keep you company on your journey through the apocalypse.

Friendly, obedient, and fiercely loyal, your dog will stay by your side and help with exploration, keeping watch, and combat, gradually becoming a reliable member of your survival team.

  • Bonding & Care : Remember to feed your dog, treat its injuries, and give it a few pats every now and then. Do that, and you'll be seeing plenty of happy tail wags.

  • Skill Training : A loyal dog knows how to help. Train it well, and it'll learn to follow your commands!

  • Pet Equipment : Collars, vests, saddlebags—you can gear your dog up too. Every piece has its purpose, so don't underestimate your four-legged teammate. Early game? You might be relying on it more than you'd expect.

Welcome to the apocalypse's very own Zombie-Uber Mercenary Service .

Need someone to do the dirty work? Hire them. Planning a long trip outside the base? One tap and we'll make sure you've got backup.

Since launch, our customer satisfaction rating has remained comfortably above 100%. Zero negative reviews so far. Totally trustworthy. Probably.

  • Who Are You Hiring? Rangers, Medics, Porters, and more—each role comes with its own strengths. Fighters go to the front, Medics keep everyone alive, and Porters haul your entire life savings back home. In the apocalypse, hiring the right person for the right job matters.

  • Commands & Combat : Stay Here, Hold Fire, Protect Me, Fire at Will—you name it. You didn't hire these people to stand around looking pretty. Give them something to do.

  • Scavenging : Before I hired you, you called me a loot goblin. Now that I'm paying you, what do you call me? Boss. Now get out there and pick up EVERYTHING. One person can't loot fast enough? Fine. Hire a whole post-apocalyptic scavenger squad.

  • Reviving Companions : Someone went down? Don't start planning the funeral just yet. Get over there, patch them up, and pull them back onto their feet. If they can still work, they can still fight. In the apocalypse, every pair of hands counts.

System Requirements

Windows

* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.
    Minimum:
    • OS *: Win XP
    • Processor: INTEL i3/ AMD R3
    • Memory: 2 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 660
    • DirectX: Version 10
    • Storage: 300 MB available space
    Recommended:
    • OS: Win 10
    • Processor: INTEL i7/ AMD R7
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM

Title: ZED ZONE
Genre: Action , Indie , RPG , Simulation
Developer: Leven Liu
Publisher: INDIECN
Release Date: Nov 5, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Mar 29, 2023




About This Game

  • Juggernaut : A pack-behavior infected that lives in symbiosis with its host organism. Yeah... it doesn't look friendly.

  • Breaker : Extremely destructive, unstable, aggressive, and short-tempered. If this thing rams into you, good luck putting yourself back together.

  • Fan Blade : A heavily modified mutant showing clear signs of artificial augmentation. We're still trying to figure out where the hell it came from.

  • Army Zombie : Damn! You must've been the kind of coward who was afraid to empty a full magazine when you were alive!

  • Flamethrower Zombie : Once a soldier who fell defending the city. Now it's everyone else's problem.

  • Firefighter Zombie : Never thought getting sprayed by this thing would hurt this much. I'm never playing with fire again.

  • Spider Robot : Four legs absolutely do NOT make it a spider. Who the hell named this thing—damn it, it saw me!

  • War Machine : So this is what they did with my tax money?! What else are they hiding from us?!

  • Giant Mutant Lizard : Wait... that thing used to be just a lizard? Has it gotten even bigger...? Oh crap, IT'S COMING!

  • Gun Modding System : Four attachment slots are now available: barrel, sight, stock, and shell collector. More than 40 weapon attachments can be installed, including scopes, night vision scopes, thermal sights, suppressed barrels, muzzle suppressors, tactical stocks, a Christmas-exclusive shell collector, and more. Mix and match attachments to freely customize weapon performance and handling.

  • Spray Paint System : Give your favorite weapon its own custom look. The game includes 8 built-in spray paints, and you can also import your own colors and images to create exactly the style you want.

  • Decals : The game also includes 8 built-in decals, and you can create custom stickers to give your weapons even more personality.

  • Construction & Production : From wells, furniture, and storage containers to furnaces and workbenches, gradually turn your base into a fully functional post-apocalyptic stronghold where you can live, craft, and produce supplies.

  • Power System : More than 10 electrical facilities and tools are now available, including generators, refrigerators, electric fences, energy storage modules, and more. It's time to light up the age of electricity once again.

  • Creative Building : Five types of material blocks are coming soon: wood, stone, metal, glass, and hay. Build your shelter however you want and create a base that truly belongs to you.

Survival is getting tougher by the day. If you want to sleep safely at night, you're going to need some serious defenses. Defensive structures and traps are already available, with automated firepower coming soon.

  • Defensive Structures : Wood Spike Traps, Metal Spike Traps, and Electric Fences help keep danger outside where it belongs.

  • Traps : Landmines, Handmade Landmines, High Explosive Landmines, and Homemade Barrel Bombs could be what gets you through the night.

  • Automated Firepower : Machine Gun Turrets, Tesla Turrets, Laser Turrets, and Crossbow Turrets. Another miracle of electrical engineering. Apocalypse-made, survivor-approved!

The game now features more than 200 craftable items , including food, medicine, tools, weapons, and other survival essentials.

  • Workbench : Craft the essentials you need to survive, along with the tools you'll never want to leave home without. And once you know what you're doing... you can probably make some pretty dangerous stuff too.

  • Lathe : In the apocalypse, if you need a part, you make it yourself. Just remember—there's no workers' compensation anymore, so watch your fingers.

  • Pharmaceuticals : It's the end of the world. You're seriously worried about allergies now? Drink it and hope for the best. If it keeps you alive, it works.

  • Chemical Experiments : This one's a little dangerous. Gunpowder, explosives, fuel... personally, I pay someone else to handle this stuff. Great output. Terrible employee retention.

The Skill System includes three major training categories: Melee, Firearms, and Fitness , with six progression directions covering blades, spears, crossbows, firearms, and more. With over 20 progression paths and 60+ skills , you can freely create your own build.

Using your PDA Terminal , you'll gradually unlock more skills. Mastering the right survival techniques might be the difference between making it home and becoming someone else's loot.

Your PDA doesn't just improve your basic capabilities—it can also provide active combat support through its onboard computing power.

Grapple, CAS System, Focused Laser Cannon, Western Gunslinger —use them at the right moment, and they might just save your life.

This time, we're adding an adorable dog to your team to keep you company on your journey through the apocalypse.

Friendly, obedient, and fiercely loyal, your dog will stay by your side and help with exploration, keeping watch, and combat, gradually becoming a reliable member of your survival team.

  • Bonding & Care : Remember to feed your dog, treat its injuries, and give it a few pats every now and then. Do that, and you'll be seeing plenty of happy tail wags.

  • Skill Training : A loyal dog knows how to help. Train it well, and it'll learn to follow your commands!

  • Pet Equipment : Collars, vests, saddlebags—you can gear your dog up too. Every piece has its purpose, so don't underestimate your four-legged teammate. Early game? You might be relying on it more than you'd expect.

Welcome to the apocalypse's very own Zombie-Uber Mercenary Service .

Need someone to do the dirty work? Hire them. Planning a long trip outside the base? One tap and we'll make sure you've got backup.

Since launch, our customer satisfaction rating has remained comfortably above 100%. Zero negative reviews so far. Totally trustworthy. Probably.

  • Who Are You Hiring? Rangers, Medics, Porters, and more—each role comes with its own strengths. Fighters go to the front, Medics keep everyone alive, and Porters haul your entire life savings back home. In the apocalypse, hiring the right person for the right job matters.

  • Commands & Combat : Stay Here, Hold Fire, Protect Me, Fire at Will—you name it. You didn't hire these people to stand around looking pretty. Give them something to do.

  • Scavenging : Before I hired you, you called me a loot goblin. Now that I'm paying you, what do you call me? Boss. Now get out there and pick up EVERYTHING. One person can't loot fast enough? Fine. Hire a whole post-apocalyptic scavenger squad.

  • Reviving Companions : Someone went down? Don't start planning the funeral just yet. Get over there, patch them up, and pull them back onto their feet. If they can still work, they can still fight. In the apocalypse, every pair of hands counts.

item.title: Wing Commander™ Prophecy: 30th Anniversary Edition
item.description:
Title: Wing Commander™ Prophecy: 30th Anniversary Edition
Genre: Action , Simulation
Developer: Origin Systems
Publisher: Electronic Arts
Franchise: Wing Commander
Release Date: Nov 5, 2026




About This Game

Wing Commander: Prophecy is an action-packed combination of one of the best sci-fi sim of the 1990s plus the amazing Secret Ops episodes.

Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community to deliver a must-see experience.

30th Anniversary Edition key improvements:

Source Master FMVs - In 2022, the Source Master tapes were discovered in the EA physical media vault. These tapes have been digitized and meticulously re-edited frame-by-frame to restore the over 150 FMV scenes, and integrate them back into the game.

Upscaled FMVs - As an optional enhancement, the FMVs have been further elevated to sharper quality using the latest in video upscaling technology for the best Wing Commander Prophecy cinematics ever seen.


Enhancement Patch Integration - Bundled with the incredible Wing Commander Prophecy Enhancement Patch built by the Wing Commander community, enabling features like the higher resolution FMVs, advanced levels of detail, and more


- Bonus extras including manuals, reference cards, player guides, and more

- Cloud Saves

This 30th Anniversary Edition is the ultimate way to enjoy one of the most important franchises in gaming history.


Original Game Descriptions:

WING COMMANDER PROPHECY

BREATHTAKING GRAPHICS
Amazingly detailed spaceships, dazzling explosions, intense lighting effects and more!

SPACE SIM OF THE YEAR
Features all the award-winning space combat action that made Wing Commander: Prophecy the king of all space simulations.

INTENSE STORY
A gripping story line unfolds as each mission you fly affects your wingmates and the outcome of the war. Experience more than 100 pulse-pounding space combat missions in all!

STAR QUALITY
Stunning cinematic sequences feature return performances by Mark Hamill, Tom Wilson, Ginger Lynn Allen and introducing Steven Petrarca as Casey.

WING COMMANDER PROPHECY SECRET OPS

INTENSE BATTLE SCENARIOS
Multi-stage capital ship strike missions create larger, more intense battles.

NEW WEAPON TECHNOLOGY
Command the galaxy with new rapid fire weapons such as the Dust Cannon, Cloud Burst and Mosquito Missiles.

POWERFUL NEW STARSHIPS
Introducing Cerberus, Confed’s first “Quick-Strike” Carrier, new Cruisers, Destroyers and civilian cruiseliners.

MORE INTENSE STORY
Continuing where Prophecy left off, join the Confederation Intelligence Services and fight for mankind’s very survival.

All Pilots Report for Duty!

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

AI was used to upscale the resolution and framerate of the master full-motion video source material, enhancing the full-motion cinematics for an optional enhanced viewing experience.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: 1.8 GHz
    • Memory: 2 GB RAM
    • Graphics: 3D graphics card compatible with DirectX 9.0c
    • DirectX: Version 9.0c
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: 1.8 GHz
    • Memory: 2 GB RAM
    • Graphics: 3D graphics card compatible with DirectX 9.0c
    • DirectX: Version 9.0c
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
